تستقذروا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْذِرُوا (tastaqḏirū) /tas.taq.ði.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# تُسْتَقْذَرُوا (tustaqḏarū) /tus.taq.ða.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
